selected_observations.excerpt: Helion Robotics Ltd is the operating name used in CRM. Invoices and Companies House use Helion Robotics Limited. That is the same legal entity. Helion Industrial Systems Ltd is a different company; it sold sensors to us in 2018 and has no current MSA.

selection_rationale: Distinct-entity assertion must be grounded in explicit source text at sources/commercial_notes.md paragraph 1, not mere co-mention.
known_missing_information: Whether the cited paragraph positively asserts DISTINCT versus merely describing separate roles is unresolved.
